meta.notes: Each item in lw_squad_equip represents one tier/quality level of an equipment piece. Items sharing the same name are upgrade tiers of the same equipment. Items with lv_group have additional percent-based upgrade sub-steps. effect = troop stats, effect_hero = hero stats, effect_dominator = dominator stats.
